title: Creative tools moved into more workflows
summary:
This week’s nine community-project updates made more ways to create, teach, and build with Pollinations easier to find.

StoryWeaver AI brought collaborative comic-making to Creative Projects, while Pollinations AI Demo and SHΞNΞRATOR added two more image-generation options. Prompt2Image joined the directory the next day, putting prompt-to-image generation in the VS Code Command Palette.

New listings covered Mixbash’s bring-your-own-key interface, a community OpenAI-compatible proxy for Pollinations text, image, and speech, and unpkg.ai’s on-demand JavaScript modules. The directory also added the official Pollinations MCP server and clarified that MCPollinations is community-maintained.

A Japanese-language chat project and EduGen AI, a Brazilian Portuguese tool that creates slide images for teachers, joined the directories with language tags and English translations.
